title: A replenished classical field has a source-reported spatial-record predictor

reported_status: The P1 continuation reports a fixed-time bound for the full spatial resolution of a continually observed, replenished classical field under specified flow assumptions, coherent hopping, and number-conserving quartic interactions. A positive current-state predictor separates preparations with matched selected populations and covariance but different future records. The report's named attachment files remain unavailable.
scientific_scope_status: For the source's classical phase-space field with divergence-free, radius-preserving flow, thermal diffusion/replenishment, and continued observation, the report gives a fixed-time spatial-resolution bound and a positive current-state predictor. Two preparations are reported to share conditional photon-number populations and covariance but have different future records. In the unit two-mode example, the stated Hermite construction at 1% error needs degree 17,499 and more than 223 billion coefficients; this is a construction cost, not a lower bound. This classical record law is distinct from the quantum replenishing-bath result N934 and the N927/N928 quantum contracts.
